children: The Federal Reserve is preparing a proposal to raise the asset-based thresholds that determine how stringently big U.S. banks are supervised-a plan that could come by year's end, Reuters reported on Friday.
Such a plan was expected by industry analysts and bankers whose lobbyists have long urged regulators to rework the levels that trigger stricter oversight of large lenders.
A spokesperson for the Fed declined to comment to Reuters, which cited anonymous sources.
This story is developing. Please check back for updates.
